text:
maria: morning — kicking off a short "shakeout" sprint for the intake path. saw benchmark flakiness on a couple small quantized models. want to tighten schema + lightweight validation before full bench runs. thoughts?
ashok: i can repro the flakiness. looks like kv-cache hit mismatch when tokenizer maps rare punctuation differently in the quantized build. low-volume but spikes cause bench noise.
devin: +1 for a focused sprint. prefer tightening interface contracts and golden inputs rather than re-running full bench farm.
kate: agree. propose adding a quick ‘compat-lint’ at ingest that fails on: missing tokenizer metadata, mismatched vocab size, and any non-deterministic tokenization observed on a small seed set.
ben: flag — adding sync checks will increase admit latency. suggestion: keep lint fast, and add an async preflight that runs heavier checks post-admit but pre-route. that way we don't block fast onboarding for trivial things.
maria: @ben can you sketch the async preflight failure modes? what happens if preflight fails after the model is already receiving traffic?
sam: if async preflight fails we should automatically route that model to a slowpath / canary cluster and roll back traffic to previous pinned model. policy: admit -> async preflight -> promote to general pool. document failure visibility in console.
onboard-bot: Admit job 9876 queued. status: queued -> running. (bot note)
ashok: quick repro snippet i used: ```python
from registry import get_model_descriptor
md = get_model_descriptor('acme-43b-8bit')
print(md['tokenizer_hash'], md['vocab_size'])
# run tokenization check
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
tok = Tokenizer.from_file(md['tokenizer_file'])
print(tok.encode('Hello, world!').tokens)
```
kate: metric names we should track in dashboards: `kv_mismatch_rate`, `tokenizer_oov_rate`, `prefill_latency_ms`, `async_preflight_failures`. add alerts for spikes.
devin: short-term rule proposal: block admission if `tokenizer_oov_rate > 0.1%` on the golden seed set. can add per-model exceptions after triage. keeps noise low.
ben: interface boundary note — keep the registry descriptor minimal: tokenizer hash, tokenizer file URL (or manifest reference), model artifact fingerprint, small canonical input bundle. do not store full tokenizer binary inline (keeps registries small).
maria: documented next steps: 1) implement compat-lint (tokenizer + metadata) 2) wire async preflight job + failure slowpath 3) add dashboard metrics + alerts 4) update onboarding docs + runbooks. sprint length: 2 weeks. volunteers?
ashok: i'll own compat-lint.
kate: i'll own dashboards/alerts.
devin: i'll prototype async preflight runner.
ben: i'll handle registry descriptor changes and rollout policy wiring.
sam: i'll update runbooks and canary routing doc.
maria: awesome. tagging @eng-platform for infra quota if we need extra canary GPUs. let's sync tomorrow 10am for scope. :rocket:
